judges.feedback: Deserved pass. The candidate implemented type-checker-like overload matching that holds up beyond the hidden tests: forward-ref TypeVar constraints, `type[A] | None`, sets and dict comprehensions, multiple ** unpackings, dict(...) built from variables, and partials of bound methods, nested partials and partials with star/dict arguments. It beats the reference on two prompt-stated cases. Minor weakness: ** unpacking of an iterable it can't infer (dict(zip(...))) is treated as empty and picks the first overload instead of falling back to the union. This is pre-existing jedi behavior and outside the stated requirements.
